releaseNotes: MP9 V1 firmware 0.3.2 — hardware-validated latest candidate: MIDI-only USB, runtime recovery, 200 ms post-mount TX hold, and pad TX self-recovery hardening (do not mark edges sent on TX failure / unmounted / DetachedHold / Cooldown; re-probe after mount / Cooldown→Idle). Keeps ENTER_BOOTLOADER / SysEx / EEPROM unchanged.
